prompt: I just finished a troubleshooting session with a customer. Their setup: an App Service called contoso-api in a vnet subnet, fronted by an Application Gateway, talking to a SQL database and a storage account. Problems I found: the storage account allows public blob access, the SQL server firewall is wide open (0.0.0.0-255.255.255.255), and the App Service still accepts TLS 1.0. Draw their architecture as an SVG and visually flag these three issues on the diagram so I can walk the customer through what to fix.
assertions: diagram.svg exists and parses as valid XML with an <svg> root element
The SVG embeds real Azure service icons (contains <symbol> definitions with <use> references, not placeholder rects) for App Service, Application Gateway, SQL, and Storage
All three problem services (App Service, SQL database, storage account) carry a visual severity highlight: red (#d13438) or orange (#ca5010) ring/badge elements positioned at those resources
A findings legend is rendered in the SVG (text 'Findings') listing all three issues with severity wording and an actionable fix/recommendation line for each
Findings are numbered, and each number appears both on the topology (badge) and in the legend
